Need to search first.I couldn't do this research, so I have no commentary notes to give you. Every source request I made failed.

**What went wrong:**
- **Page fetches:** I tried to open five pages directly: Enduring Word on Psalm 145, the Bible Hub commentary pages for verses 9 and 13, Precept Austin's Psalm 145 page and the NET Bible notes. The tool refused all five because it only opens addresses that have first come up in a search. I should have searched first.
- **Searches:** I then tried twelve searches, covering Enduring Word, Bible Hub, Spurgeon, Precept Austin, the NET Bible, Desiring God, Catholic and Wesleyan sources, and specific questions on verses 9, 13, 15 and 18. They were rejected because I had reached the tool's usage limit for this turn, so no results came back.

Your rules say to report only what I actually read, with a link for each point. Since I read nothing, writing notes from memory would break that rule, so I've left them out.

**How to get the commentary:**
- **Ask again in a new message.** The limit should reset. I would search first and then open the pages that come up. That covers all three parts of your request: the traditional reading verse by verse, where Protestant traditions differ, and other well-known views.
- **Tell me which parts matter most** if you'd like a smaller first pass. For example, I could start with the verse-by-verse commentaries (Enduring Word, Bible Hub, Spurgeon) and do the questions where traditions differ next.
- **Send me the pages yourself.** You can give me the addresses or paste in the text, and I'll write the notes only from those.
